*Note* - Mr. Naidu has presented that with respect to social services, the capital expenditure in 2022-23 was lower than that during 2018-19 and with this isolated comparison between only two years, is trying to say that the capital expenditure in the crucial social sector that encompasses education, health, water supply, sanitation and urban development, social welfare and nutrition, has reduced by 84.3%. As can be seen in the table, the average capital incurred in social services sector during 2019-24 is more than double of what was incurred during 2014-19.
